osm_tags.description: Primarily operating in the Bering Sea and Gulf of Alaska, NOAA Ship Oscar Dyson is the first in a class of ultra-quiet fisheries survey vessels collecting data on fish populations, conduct marine mammal and seabird surveys, and study marine ecosystems.
osm_tags.name: NOAAS Oscar Dyson

osm_tags.description: Primary missions are enforcing fisheries regulations, responding to search and rescue cases, providing medical evacuations in the Bering Sea and Gulf of Alaska, and sometimes as far as west as the Sea of Japan, and as far south as San Diego or Hawaii.
osm_tags.name: USCGC Alex Haley
